v0.4.2 — Real charts in the documentation
A documentation release. The library code is the same as [v0.4.1](https://github.com/miluta7/geoveil-cn0/releases/tag/v0.4.1).

<img src="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/miluta7/geoveil-cn0/v0.4.2/docs/img/real_signal_monitor.webp" width="480" alt="Real geoveil-cn0 output for BOR1 on 2025-12-31">

- The README now shows real geoveil-cn0 output: the BOR1 CN0 skyplot and 24-hour timeline, mean CN0 by elevation for each constellation, and the quality score for one hour of 1 Hz data from Bucharest. The earlier illustrations are gone.
- The images now render on PyPI.

```bash
pip install -U geoveil-cn0
```

**Links:** [Website](https://miluta7.github.io/geoveil-cn0/) · [PyPI](https://pypi.org/project/geoveil-cn0/0.4.2/) · [Changelog](https://github.com/miluta7/geoveil-cn0/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)
